steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Apply an Auction template before adding line items.
Add the required auction item.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet for the item.

args.goal: On the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes as None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop with the Terms & Conditions section showing the two clauses.

steps.note: Add the two optional event/stage clauses; no dedicated catalog step exists for configuring clauses.
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Add one QA test vendor for Vendor A.
Publish the configured eRFX Auction event.
Verify that publishing reached the event page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open this event's Auction pricing round as the vendor.
Verify the first clause is visible in the vendor's Terms & Conditions block.
Verify the second clause is visible in the vendor's Terms & Conditions block.
Accept the first optional clause.
Accept the second optional clause.
Submit the vendor's bid after accepting both clauses.
Assert that the vendor bid was submitted successfully.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Verify that the buyer sees the vendor response, while the catalog lacks an assertion for clause acceptance status.
